_doc: CA standalone nursing home muni obligor universe for muni-credit detector framework
_methodology: Compiled May 2026 from CSCDA bond issuance announcements, CHFFA staff reports, HCAI Cal-Mortgage insured project list, Bond Buyer, Ziegler press releases, individual obligor sites, ProPublica Nursing Home Inspect, US News Best Nursing Homes, HCAI facility pages, and CMS Care Compare lookups. CCNs (Federal Provider Numbers) for CA SNFs use the 555xxx format (not 056xxx).
_caveats: The CA standalone-SNF muni universe is small. Most nonprofit CA SNFs that access the muni market do so as the SNF component of a CCRC obligated group, not as standalone obligors. Pure standalone CA SNF muni obligors number well under 20. This file therefore includes: (a) the handful of true standalone SNF obligors identified, plus (b) CCRC obligors whose obligated group includes meaningful (50+ bed) SNF beds where the SNF revenue is a material driver. CCRC-with-SNF hybrids are flagged in notes. Hospital-affiliated SNFs that share a hospital obligor (Salinas Valley, Palomar, MarinHealth) are EXCLUDED because the muni bond is the hospital's, not the SNF's. Ratings as of most recent published action 2023-2026.
_excluded_explicitly: Eskaton Care Center Greenhaven/Manzanita/Fair Oaks (sold to Cypress Healthcare Group/IEP in 2023; no longer muni obligors). Westside Christian Convalescent and St. Anne's Home San Francisco (closed). Pure for-profit chains (Brius, Covenant Care, Generations, Country Villa, Windsor, ReNew) have no muni access.

obligors.name: Ararat Home of Los Angeles
obligors.legal_obligor_name: Ararat Home of Los Angeles, Inc.
obligors.conduit_issuer: California Health Facilities Financing Authority (Cal-Mortgage insured)
obligors.notes: Armenian community SNF + CCRC. Cal-Mortgage-insured 2023 Series ($10.485M) reimbursed Ararat Gardens acquisition (Glendale). Three campuses: Mission Hills (CCRC+SNF), Eagle Rock (standalone SNF), Ararat Gardens Glendale (CCRC+SNF). Total 324 SNF beds across three SNFs. Mission Hills CCN 555579. CCRC component small; SNF is dominant business.

obligors.name: Bethany Home Society of San Joaquin County
obligors.legal_obligor_name: Bethany Home Society of San Joaquin County
obligors.notes: Cal-Mortgage insured Jan 2023 for $49.56M. Listed as CCRC by Cal-Mortgage but very SNF-heavy multi-level facility (92 SNF beds dominate the campus). Single-site Christian non-profit. 5-star CMS rating per Care Compare. CCN reported as 055662 by US News but verify (CA SNFs use 555xxx series; 055662 may be alternate format).

obligors.name: Atherton Baptist Homes
obligors.conduit_issuer: City of Alhambra (insured refunding revenue bonds) / Cal-Mortgage history
obligors.notes: Type C CCRC with 99-bed SNF. 2016 Fitch BB on Series 2016 insured refunding ($29.09M); 2024 audited FS published. No 2024+ rating action found within search budget. Christian (Baptist) affiliated. CCN unverified.

obligors.name: San Francisco Campus for Jewish Living
obligors.legal_obligor_name: San Francisco Campus for Jewish Living (fka Jewish Home and Rehabilitation Center / Jewish Home of San Francisco)
obligors.notes: 5-star CMS-rated SNF. Historically standalone SNF + acute geriatric psych hospital; expanded into 190-unit residential care (113 AL + 77 memory care) with 2021 build. Hybrid SNF/RCFE — SNF still dominant. CCN 555169 (US News reports 055169 format). Cal-Mortgage insured.

obligors.name: Los Angeles Jewish Health (Los Angeles Jewish Home for the Aging)
obligors.legal_obligor_name: Los Angeles Jewish Home for the Aging (LAJHA) and affiliates
obligors.notes: Two campuses (Grancell Village, Eisenberg Village). 271 SNF beds at Eisenberg + 239 SNF beds at Joyce Eisenberg-Keefer (Grancell) + 10-bed psych. Eisenberg SNF CCN per US News = 4-star CMS-rated. CCRC structure but ~510 SNF beds dominate. Multiple CCNs (one per campus); unverified within search budget.

obligors.name: Solheim Senior Community (Solheim Lutheran Home)
obligors.city_county: Eagle Rock/Los Angeles, Los Angeles County
obligors.notes: CCRC (founded 1923 Norwegian Lutheran). 2004 CHFFA financing identified; unclear if any muni debt remains outstanding 2025. Small obligor. CCN unverified. Flagged as POSSIBLE rather than confirmed outstanding.

obligors.name: Pilgrim Place in Claremont
obligors.notes: Small CCRC with Health Services Center (SNF). CHFFA 2016 financing identified. Small obligor; SNF is small component. CCN unverified.

obligors.name: Mount San Antonio Gardens
obligors.notes: 501(c)(3) CCRC Life Plan Community. CMFA $43.78M bond in 2023 financed/refinanced including SNF beds. CCN 055016 per US News (likely alternate-format 555016).

obligors.name: Carmel Valley Manor
obligors.conduit_issuer: California Municipal Finance Authority (CMFA) / Cal-Mortgage ($36.035M Sept 2022)
obligors.notes: CCRC with embedded SNF + rehab. Ziegler-arranged $36M financing in 2022. CCN unverified within search budget. Small SNF component.

obligors.name: Aldersly Garden Retirement Community
obligors.notes: Danish-heritage CCRC. Cal-Mortgage insured June 2023. Very small 20-bed SNF; mostly IL/AL/MC. CCN 555694 per CareListings. SNF component minor.

obligors.name: The Redwoods, A Community of Seniors
obligors.notes: CCRC. Cal-Mortgage insured 2022 ($23.55M). CCN 555826 per Seniorly. Small CCRC.

obligors.name: O'Connor Woods
obligors.notes: CCRC with Meadowood Skilled Nursing & Rehabilitation. Cal-Mortgage insured 2021. CCN unverified within search budget.

obligors.name: Plymouth Village (HumanGood)
obligors.legal_obligor_name: HumanGood SoCal (fka be.group / Plymouth Village obligor)
obligors.conduit_issuer: California Municipal Finance Authority (CMFA, up to $205M approved 2024-2025)
obligors.notes: Plymouth Village is HumanGood (post-ABHOW merger) CCRC. CMFA approved up to $205M tax-exempt revenue bonds 2024-2025 for upgrades. Includes long-term skilled nursing. HumanGood is the master obligor (much larger; 125+ communities), so Plymouth-specific SNF disclosure is consolidated.

obligors.name: Front Porch Communities and Services (Covia)
obligors.notes: Front Porch (Covia merger) operates multiple CCRCs across CA including St. Paul's Towers Oakland (320-bed community), Spring Lake Village Santa Rosa, and others with skilled nursing. Material SNF bed count (~400+) across obligated group. CSCDA Series 2021 $305.565M. Master obligor, not facility-level. Multiple CCNs.

_known_excluded_with_reason.name: Eskaton Obligated Group
_known_excluded_with_reason.reason: Eskaton sold standalone SNFs (Greenhaven, Manzanita, Fair Oaks) to Cypress Healthcare Group / IEP in 2023; 2024 Series ($82.895M, BBB Fitch, CMFA conduit) backs CCRC obligated group with minimal embedded SNF beds remaining. Borderline include.

_known_excluded_with_reason.name: Sequoia Living (fka NCPHS)
_known_excluded_with_reason.reason: CCRC; Cal-Mortgage insured $151.555M July 2025. SNF at The Sequoias SF, Portola Valley, The Tamalpais Marin. CCRC-dominant — borderline CCRC universe not SNF universe.

_known_excluded_with_reason.name: Odd Fellows Home of California
_known_excluded_with_reason.reason: Pure CCRC; Cal-Mortgage insured 2023 $67.065M + 2026 $101.745M. 94-bed SNF embedded but CCRC-dominant. Belongs in CCRC universe.

_known_excluded_with_reason.name: Moldaw Residences
_known_excluded_with_reason.reason: Pure assisted living + memory care + hospice; NO licensed SNF beds. Excluded.

_known_excluded_with_reason.name: Casa de las Campanas (San Diego)
_known_excluded_with_reason.reason: Type A+C CCRC; not yet confirmed as muni obligor in search budget.

_known_excluded_with_reason.name: Mercy Retirement & Care Center (Oakland)
_known_excluded_with_reason.reason: Eldercare Alliance (small affiliate of Transforming Age) CCRC. No CSCDA/CHFFA bond confirmed in search budget.

_known_excluded_with_reason.name: On Lok Senior Health Services
_known_excluded_with_reason.reason: CHFFA 2024 $80M bond — but On Lok is PACE program (community-based alternative to nursing home), NOT a licensed SNF. Excluded from SNF universe.

_known_excluded_with_reason.name: AltaMed Health Services
_known_excluded_with_reason.reason: CHFFA 2022 $129.568M — but AltaMed is FQHC + PACE, not SNF. Excluded.

_known_excluded_with_reason.name: Salinas Valley Health, Palomar Health, MarinHealth, Tri-City Healthcare District SNFs
_known_excluded_with_reason.reason: SNF beds owned by hospital districts; muni bond is the hospital's general obligation/revenue, not SNF-specific. Belongs in CA hospital universe.

_distress_signals_identified: Eskaton: 2022 covenant violations on DSCR and DCOH; $14M of $16.4M operating loss from the three SNFs that were subsequently sold. Bonds refinanced 2024 at BBB.
Industry-wide: nonprofit senior living defaults remained above 8% in 2024 (Bond Buyer); skilled nursing the riskiest sub-sector. Many CA nonprofits selling to for-profit operators.
St. Anne's Home San Francisco closed permanently (April 2026).
_ccn_match_rate: 7 of 14 (50%) — Ararat Mission Hills 555579, Bethany Ripon 055662, SF Campus Jewish Living 555169, Mount San Antonio Gardens 055016, Aldersly 555694, Redwoods 555826. Note CA CCN format: state lists report both 555xxx (HCAI) and 055xxx (US News alternate) — same number, different prefix conventions. CMS Care Compare official format is 555xxx. Remaining 7 obligors have CCNs unverified within search budget — many are CCRC obligors where SNF CCN(s) exist per HCAI but were not matched to obligor name on this pass.
